rationale: Evidence from iteration 6 (score 890.5, best so far): oval 20/20 finished (mean 2.10 s, rms 0.005), s-bend 20/20 (mean 2.39 s, rms 0.013), slalom 15/20 finished with 5 off-track exits, mean progress 0.92, 0.3 line-loss events per run. The oval and s-bend are essentially saturated, so the remaining score gap (slalom about 774 against about 950) is entirely slalom reversal tracking. Iteration 6 raised kd from 2.5 to 3.0 and slalom finishes went from 13/20 to 15/20, so extra damping helps. Raising kp to 5.0 (iteration 5) made things worse, so proportional gain is near its useful limit. Speed is not the constraint (no slalom timeouts at base_speed 0.95). The remaining hypothesis from iteration 6 is sensor coverage: with five sensors at +/-0.04 m and 0.02 m spacing, the tape leaves the array at sharp reversals before the controller can react. Change (single variable, the sensor layout): seven sensors evenly spaced across +/-0.04 m at about 0.0133 m pitch, so the array covers the same width at finer resolution. Sensor weights are set to 50 times the sensor x-position (-2, -4/3, -2/3, 0, 2/3, 4/3, 2), which keeps the steering signal scale identical to the iteration 6 design (where weight 1 sat at x = 0.02 m). Everything else is held at the iteration 6 values (kp 4.5, ki 0, kd 3.0, base_speed 0.95, mass 0.6, body 0.15 x 0.12 m, track 0.11 m, radius 0.03 m, sensor size 0.012 m, line_loss last_direction). Expected result: slalom off-track exits drop from 5 toward 2 or fewer and slalom progress rises above 0.95, with oval and s-bend unchanged near 950 and 945. Hypotheses to check next: (1) if slalom steering_oscillation rises above 0.32 or the oval shows jitter, the finer array is noisier and sensor_size should drop to 0.008 to sharpen readings; (2) if slalom still leaves at progress near 0.92, steering authority at reversals is the limit and wheel_track should narrow to 0.10 m; (3) if the oval completion_time rises above 2.6 s, base_speed should go back to 0.9. Measurements requested: all metrics per track, to compare slalom finish count, off-track versus finished split, and line_loss_events directly with iteration 6.
